verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and data API, so a scraper marketplace with revenue sharing is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only first-party scrape, crawl, extract, monitoring and brand APIs, plus an SDK, CLI and MCP server. Nothing shows developers can publish custom scrapers to a public marketplace or earn revenue from others' usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
